fields.title: ChattyM
fields.description: ChattyM is a minimal social network built with Django 5, PostgreSQL, and Bootstrap 5 that demonstrates core web development features. It offers email-based authentication via django-allauth, editable user profiles with avatars and birthdays, and full CRUD for posts, comments, and likes. Users can follow/unfollow others, view a personalized feed, send direct messages, and administrators can moderate content; fixtures are provided to populate test data. The project includes a DRF-based REST API with Swagger docs, token/session auth, and a Dockerized setup for easy local development and testing.

fields.title: What2Cook
fields.description: What2Cook — lightweight recipe finder: give it the ingredients you have and it will suggest recipes. Built with **FastAPI**, async SQLAlchemy, Postgres, Jinja2 templates and a small, responsive frontend..

fields.title: AutoService Book
fields.description: AutoService Book is your reliable assistant for tracking and managing your car’s service history. This web application, built as a portfolio project, showcases skills in Django development, database management, and creating user-friendly interfaces.
